tasks.title: Record exact payload production and closure
tasks.goal: Turn existing source/prebuilt/build artifacts into independently verifiable realization inputs and outputs.
steps: Extend existing provider results with full source/toolchain/config/executor/target inputs, declared outputs and dependency roles rather than adding a parallel evidence store.
Support captured prebuilt files/archives and an explicit build recipe; bind output inventory and digest independently of recipe identity.
Exercise an isolated declared-input Linux build without network after preparation and report providers lacking enforcement as non-hermetic/unavailable.
positive_cases: Captured prebuilt and source-build paths produce equivalent declared runtime inventories.
negative_cases: A successful handler without complete output inventory is called a verified realization.
Ambient compiler, libc or network satisfies an undeclared hermetic dependency.
checks: TO CREATE: source/prebuilt realization and declared-input isolation fixtures.
acceptance: Input identity, output identity and reproducibility claim are separate fields backed by evidence.
All-input missing states refuse before activation.
tasks.safe_stop: Verified realization artifacts exist in fixture storage; no profile is activated.
notes: Planned permanent destination: vibevm/vibespecs/common/PROP-064-runtime-package-management.xml; forward metadata only.

Use full listed crate tests by default. If narrowing to a newly created test filter, first run cargo test -p <crate> -- --list and verify an exact nonzero test-name match; a zero-test run is not acceptance.
Registration perimeter includes existing crate manifests and module owners only for required exports/dependencies; do not change unrelated declarations.

tasks.title: Realize payload files with target filesystem semantics
tasks.goal: Validate archives and preserve ordinary tools' files, links and modes without exposing host paths.
steps: Pre-enumerate archive entries and metadata; reject traversal, duplicate/overlapping outputs, case collisions and link escape before writes.
Install into a staged target-bound store using Linux metadata semantics for Linux payloads; verify content, modes and link targets independently after extraction.
Represent unsupported xattrs/capabilities/device nodes explicitly; permit legitimate target-root absolute symlinks without following them into the Windows host.
positive_cases: Executable modes and safe relative/absolute-in-root symlinks survive Linux realization.
Two tools share one exact runtime dependency payload.
negative_cases: A malicious link or hardlink escapes the staged root.
NTFS copying is treated as proof of POSIX metadata preservation.
checks: TO CREATE: archive traversal/link/mode corpus and Linux metadata integration test.
acceptance: All written paths match the admitted inventory and target root.
Extraction failures preserve a staged partial result that cannot be activated as complete.
tasks.safe_stop: Only verified staging content exists; rejected stages are retained or removed under exact ownership.

tasks.title: Unify legacy binary dispatch and trusted substitution
tasks.goal: Route installed command selection through validated artifact/closure records instead of existence or debug-first fallback.
steps: Replace public legacy existence/debug-first dispatch with the same recorded artifact validation used by new realization paths; keep user-visible compatibility where proof exists.
Validate substitute producer policy, closure/content/recipe/target and store-prefix compatibility before reuse; rebuild or explicitly refuse incompatible prefix-bound binaries.
Add command/path/exec regressions for corrupt/missing records, compatible caches and multiple command providers; no hidden GitHub or model execution.
positive_cases: Legacy valid binary records resolve through the shared validator.
An authorized exact substitute runs from a compatible profile prefix.
negative_cases: A stray target/debug binary wins over a recorded release artifact.
Binary strings are blindly rewritten to relocate a prefix-bound payload.
acceptance: All public binary paths share one validation authority.
Corrupt or unrecorded binaries return structured diagnostics rather than execute.
tasks.safe_stop: Binary routing passes fixtures and no real user's activation links are changed.
